ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure there is a hexagon A B C D E F, with the vertices enclosing the polygon in order. In the figure, expressions are marked beside each interior angle: at A it is (x+2)°, at B it is (x-8)°, at C it is (x+7)°, at D it is (x-3)°, at E it is (x+6)°, and at F it is (x-4)°. The problem asks to find m∠D. Then reason: The sum of the interior angles of a hexagon is (6-2)×180=720°. Therefore adding the six interior angles gives: (x+2)+(x-8)+(x+7)+(x-3)+(x+6)+(x-4)=720. Combining like terms, the constant terms 2-8+7-3+6-4=0, so 6x=720, solving gives x=120. The expression for ∠D in the figure is (x-3)°, substituting x=120 gives m∠D=120-3=117°.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：这是一个六边形 A B C D E F，每个顶点旁都标了内角表达式，分别是 A 处 (x+2)°、B 处 (x-8)°、C 处 (x+7)°、D 处 (x-3)°、E 处 (x+6)°、F 处 (x-4)°。再看题目文字：要求的是 m∠D。用六边形内角和公式 (6-2)×180=720°，把图中六个角的表达式相加： (x+2)+(x-8)+(x+7)+(x-3)+(x+6)+(x-4)=720，得到 6x=720，所以 x=120。最后回到图中 D 角的表达式是 (x-3)°，代入得 120-3=117°，所以 m∠D=117°。
